plants.name: Sickle fern
plants.role: Fronds of small sickles down a jointed stem. Grazers strip a frond at a time; it grows them back.

plants.name: Rib reed
plants.role: A bed of thin reeds with rib pairs up each. Small things feed in it and hide in it.

plants.name: Lantern bulb
plants.role: A jar-shaped fruit on a short stem between long leaves. One big meal; the fruit takes a while to swell again.

plants.name: Flame bloom
plants.role: Five broad petals round a bead, a flame drawn at the root of each. Grazers take a petal at a time.

plants.name: Arch orchid
plants.role: One stem that arches over to the side, with blossoms hanging from its end. Flyers feed at the blossoms; the stem is left alone.

plants.name: Warden bloom
plants.role: An eye on a stalk, lidded like a flower. It watches; what comes close enough it shuts on.

plants.name: Claw snare
plants.role: A ring of claws round a pit in the floor, open like a dish. Step in and it closes.

plants.name: Sickle maw
plants.role: Two great sickles on a stem, held open as jaws, fanged at the hinge. It takes what flies between them.

plants.name: Tentacle lurker
plants.role: A bulb in the floor with curling arms laid out round it. It lies still and takes whatever moves across them.

plants.name: Cone snare
plants.role: A spined cone with a skirt of long narrow petals hanging round it. What lands on the cone, the petals close over.

plants.name: Carrion crown
plants.role: A crown that opens over a skull. It only flowers where something has died: a carcass nearby brings it up, and its bloom feeds scavengers.

plants.name: Spore lantern
plants.role: A sealed pod on a stem. When something is eaten close by, it bursts and lets its spores out; what eats a spore carries it.

items.note: Eats close by: the pod bursts

plants.name: Ladder bloom
plants.role: A ladder of spine pieces. Each meal taken near it adds a rung; at the top it opens a ring, and the ring is fruit.

plants.name: Fork oak
plants.role: A trunk that forks, and forks again, with a leaf at every tip. A walker passing under it shakes it: leaves fall, and the fall feeds the small things on the floor.

plants.name: Thorn nurse
plants.role: A thorn tree: every branch ends in a horn. Small things shelter in it. When a trapper near it has fed, the nurse fruits: the two grow together.
